summary: PIM Manager installs in two lines, and settings can be exported and imported.

new.title: Install in two lines
new.text: PIM Manager installs in two lines with a browser sign-in, in Community and Pro alike.

new.title: Export and import settings
new.text: You can export your settings to a file and import them from one.

new.title: Guards show a red count
new.text: The Guards menu shows a red count when a guard holds changes for a SuperAdmin.

new.title: New options, off by default
new.text: Eligible group owners and a nightly demo reset are built in, both off by default.

fixes.title: Engine rights follow your scopes
fixes.text: The engine's Azure rights follow the scopes you define, never Owner. After an update, PIM Manager reports any new permission the engine needs.

fixes.title: Fewer unneeded engine runs
fixes.text: Engine runs are skipped when nothing changed; a full check still runs every 4 hours.

fixes.title: No false not role-assignable label
fixes.text: An Azure refusal that heals on the next run is no longer labelled group not role-assignable.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The Departments grid no longer shows blank rows, and restoring a list setting keeps its keys.
